title: Soul Feast #10: Cooperation: Your Soul’s Intention
excerpt: In today’s soul feast, Gary Zukav dives into the soul’s intention of cooperation and how it differs fundamentally from mere collaboration rooted in fear or self-interest.
bodyHtml:
In today’s soul feast, Gary Zukav dives into the soul’s intention of cooperation and how it differs fundamentally from mere collaboration rooted in fear or self-interest. 

Continuing his exploration of the intentions of the soul – harmony, sharing, reverence for life, and cooperation – Gary provides insights into how aligning our actions with love creates not only cooperation, but also joy through co-creation.

Gary contrasts traditional collaboration, often driven by motives like personal gain or safety, with cooperation and co-creation, acts grounded in love and spiritual partnership. 

He shares stories, personal experiences, and wisdom on how to discern between cooperation that is coming from fear and true co-creation that contributes to life.

If you’re ready to explore the difference between participating out of fear versus contributing with love and your Soul’s intentions, this soul feast is a must-listen.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

    • (01:48): The distinction between cooperation rooted in fear and cooperation that is driven by love – cocreation.
    • (05:20): How intention shapes the outcome of your cooperative actions.
    • (10:45): The fulfillment and joy that comes from co-creation in spiritual partnership.
    • (13:00): The role of love and fear as the fundamental dualities shaping every choice.
    • (16:30): Why cocreation is impossible without love and how to cultivate it in your actions.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Take your soul journal and reflect on moments of cooperation in your daily life. Were your actions motivated by fear – seeking approval, safety, or personal gain? Or by love, fostering connection and contributing to the greater good? Use this reflection to guide you toward creating more meaningful co-creations.
